properties.description: At start, a --registry-root server raises its soft RLIMIT_NOFILE to the hard limit (on macOS as far as kern.maxfilesperproc, then OPEN_MAX 10240, allow) and logs the raise. It then checks --registry-max-open × (MAX_OPEN_FILES_PER_STORE 64 + 12 fixed files a design keeps) + 32 of the server's own against the soft limit. When they do not fit it prints one WARNING line on stderr naming the three numbers, the total, and what to change (raise the limit to the total, saying whether the hard limit allows it, or lower --registry-max-open to the count that fits), and keeps running. The 12 is 7 handles measured per design on 2026-10-28 (WAL, MANIFEST, LOCK, LOG, two store-directory handles, the full-text index's writer lock) plus 5 allowed for files a design opens for a moment. Code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/file_handles.rs (raise_to_hard_limit, Budget::warning), called from main.rs's registry branch before any design opens.
properties.name: A server holding many designs raises its open-file limit at start and warns when its designs could need more files than the limit allows
